name: PayFine
description: Use only when the NPC is a guard who has just fined the player for walking about naked in public, and the player agrees to pay that fine on the spot. The server checks a fine is owed and the game takes the gold from the player. Never for a thane, never for a first warning, and not if the player refuses (then the guard may use ReportCrime instead).
note: Living World public decency (MANTELLA_LIVING_WORLD=1). Handled by the Living World server (livingworld/guard/decency.py); the game only takes the gold the server names.
prompt: If you are a guard who fined the player for public nakedness and they agree to pay it now, begin your response with '{key}:'
